fit_settings.note: simulated traces (pump-limited) are convolved with the probe duration and fitted with model (x) Gaussian IRF

characteristic_times.lattice_equilibration_definition: time after which the spread of branch effective temperatures falls below 10% of its maximum

branches.branch_order: branches sorted by frequency at each q; 0-2 acoustic

diffuse_definition: one-phonon intensity I1(Q) = sum_nu (n+1/2)/omega |sum_s f_s(|Q|)/sqrt(M_s) (Q.e_s) exp(-i G.r_s)|^2 at Q = q + G for all symmetry-equivalent q of the special point (nearest grid point) and all G with |Q| < qmax in the plane normal to the beam; dI/I0 = I(t)/I(t<0) - 1

electrons.model: universal sp3 Slater-Koster (Harrison 1980) + NIST LDA term values
